design_reasoning: The exact public signatures, aliases, type-only SavedWorkflowMeta identity and sentinel literal initializers are retained from the packet.

Sentinel recognition uses one native trim and exact equality; serialization creates a fresh plain metadata record in description/whenToUse/args order, includes optional keys only when not undefined, preserves args identity and raw script, and calls original stringifyYaml once without interception.

Parsing splits only on newline, skips leading trim-empty lines, requires the first nonempty supported sentinel and first isolated trimmed closing marker, and uses slice/join to retain all remaining carriage returns, empty lines, trailing newlines and the absolute closing-line offset.

Only the original YAML parse call is caught. Its thrown Error message or String conversion is retained. Original schema safeParse receives the exact YAML result with its native receiver; failure issue order, path formatting and prose are retained; success keeps parsed.data reference identity.

Original YAML and SavedWorkflowMetaSchema are opaque imported ports. No parser/schema/policy replacement or standalone semantic closure is claimed. Required static schema expressions remain their original owners; this allocated codec exports only its required sentinel initializers.

Required parsing markers, fixed metadata keys, error prose, literal initializers and public static material are source-derived preservation data and receive no novelty credit. No business execution, licence decision or rights grant is made.
